title: Day 13x — What a MEMS Accelerometer Is

slides.title: Where we are
items: Yesterday we wired the LSM303AGR, read 0x33 out of its WHO_AM_I register, and watched the transactions on the logic analyzer — without knowing what is inside the chip.
Today is the inside: the physics that senses acceleration, the datasheet's numbers, and the format the data will arrive in tomorrow.
slides.presenterNote: 50 minutes today: 2 settling + 1 announcements, then Parts of 11 / 3 / 9 / 19 / 3, and a 2-minute close. Kits stay in bags — nothing is wired today; the load is all conceptual, and Part 4 is the crucial step. No checkpoint minutes exist; if a Part runs long, Part 2 drops to one example (−2) and the close absorbs one minute.
